notes: 2026-08-28 (branch feat/dispatch-addon-enforcement, SECOND commit — stacked on the devmode/dispatch batch) — impersonation identity follows the impersonated tenant + admins stop resurrecting as drivers. (A) Impersonation: lib/impersonation.ts gained an `impersonationUsername` key (ImpersonationState.username, setImpersonation(token, slug, username?)) and parseExp now base64url-decodes (`-`→`+`, `_`→`/`) — atob on a raw segment THREW, so `expired` was pinned false forever; subscribeImpersonation's storage listener is now KEY-FILTERED (token/slug/username + key===null for clear()) because the unfiltered one fired on every cross-tab write and the new subscribers would log idle tabs out. auth-context.tsx + tenant-provider.tsx now subscribe (NON-NULL reads only; no refreshTokens() fallback), admin/tenants LIST page matches the [id] page (setImpersonation + setTenantCookie + hard window.location.href), and the banner's Exit is a hard load onto /admin/tenants showing `acting as {imp.username ?? "Tenant Admin"}`. (B) Drivers: platform-admin createTenant/createTenantAdmin no longer auto-create a Driver row and write canActAsDriver:false (Settings → Act as driver / users.service.toggleDriverPermit is the sole opt-in, unchanged); drivers.service.remove() reads the linked user.role in-tx — pure DRIVER logins still deleted, dual-role OPERATOR/TENANT_ADMIN logins NEVER deleted and get canActAsDriver:false instead (the unconditional user.delete hit restrict-FKs, rolled the whole tx back, and made deleted admin drivers "come back"). Spec: drivers.service.spec.ts describe("remove"). In passing: jwt.strategy validate() now copies canActAsDriver into req.user (RolesGuard's dual-role branch was dead server-side; widen-only, and the flag is minted at login so a permit change still needs re-login). isAdmin is deliberately NOT propagated — its only req.user consumer is the PATCH /users/:id/admin gate (users.controller.ts), which passes only TENANT_ADMINs today BECAUSE the claim is dropped; surfacing it would silently let admin-flagged OPERATORs assign admin rights.
